figures.title: Secular density trend comparison
figures.role_message: The paper-organizing result: present a vector reconstruction of Brown et al. 2024 Figure 2's literature altitude profile beside updated solar-adjusted altitude-resolved estimates.
figures.panel_layout_contract: Two directly adjacent equal-width axes share a fixed 0–850 km altitude axis. Panel A is rendered from plot-precision values vector-extracted from Brown et al. 2024 Figure 2, with its 16-study four-column legend in the empty 740–850 km band; it is not original study data. Panel B shows Thermodense's updated solar-adjusted altitude-resolved estimates including paired JB2006/JB2008 Mauna Loa baselines.
datasets: Brown et al. 2024 Figure 2 literature profiles
figures.implementation_status_blockers: The fail-closed Figure 6 compositor and full-history 1967–2026 MSIS producer are implemented. The validated local external JB pair covers 1997-01-06 through 2026-04-19 at identical 125–825 km altitudes, excluding 1998-05-17 through 1999-03-15 for both models under the official SET proxy-validity threshold. Its contract includes date, F10.7_OBS_CENTER81, jb2006_log10rho_daily_mean_<alt>km, and jb2008_log10rho_daily_mean_<alt>km. Final output may never include only one JB model. Portability remains gated by SET wrapper-distribution permission: do not add provider software, indices, or translated JB code. Panel A uses data/derived/literature/brown_2024_figure2_digitized.csv: 427 plot-precision values vector-extracted from Brown Figure 2 for 16 studies under CC BY 4.0 (repository SHA-256 checksum 1fafa2718250adcd01677d4c9257cef4f72d3e7d654a7a14accc2c8cdc216583), not replacements for original study data. The external publisher PDF remains provenance/reference only; do not infer altitude profiles from Brown's 400-km tables.
figures.compositor_contract: .venv/bin/python -m scripts.recreate_brown_density_trend_current --require-jb --jb-path PATH then .venv/bin/python -m scripts.compose_density_trend_figure6 --require-jb [--brown-data PATH] [--trend-csv PATH] [--output-dir PATH] (scripts/compose_density_trend_figure6.py) vector-renders the bundled Brown reconstruction at x=-7..1 with its study legend, shares a 0–850 km altitude axis, and preserves Panel B as vector PDF. The no-flag compositor output is a draft.
